Sewing Machine Operators use industrial sewing equipment to join cut pieces into garments or components according to process requirements. They control stitch length, stitching, and seam allowance and assist with machine adjustment for style changes and self-inspection.

paragraphs: Before work, collect cut pieces and process sheets and adjust the presser foot and tension. On the line, sew garment bodies, align seam allowances, and monitor stitching consistency. Readjust equipment during style changes, replenish materials at midday, then self-inspect, remove thread scraps, and separate defective items before leaving.
